Remote Support Software for Mobile Devices

Comprehensive Mobile Device Support With AnyDesk

Buy Now

Cross-compatible & platform-independent

Our mobile solution is available for Android and iOS and offers the possibility to connect, access and control desktops, servers, machines, and devices via smartphone or tablet. Cross-compatible and platform independent, with a variety of thought-through features for a comprehensive remote experience.

Mobile remote connections

With AnyDesk, seamless cross-compatibility between devices is possible on a variety of operating systems. Whether you're accessing a desktop from your iPhone, iPad, Android smartphone, or Android tablet – or vice versa – AnyDesk provides you the mobile solution that works across all your devices. Offer customers and clients a wide range of support and the best customer experience possible, no matter which device or operating system is used.

Mobile Remote Access

Whether on the road, working from home or on a business trip, with AnyDesk you can access files, applications, desktops, servers and more from wherever you are! Our mobile solution grants you easy and secure access from your iOS devices (iPhone and iPad) and Android devices (smartphones and tablets), ensuring you stay productive on any mobile platform.

Mobile Remote Control

Not only does AnyDesk enable you to access devices with different operating systems, but it also allows you to control them remotely as if you were in front of them – even with Android devices. We offer many features for Android and iOS to provide everything for a great remote connectivity without overstaining users.

Highlights

Mobile Device Support

The mobile solution of AnyDesk is available for Android and iOS. You can download our mobile solution in the official app store of your device and on our website for increased security.

Learn More

Platform-independent

With our mobile solution you can connect to devices with a variety of operating systems, including: Windows, Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD, Raspberry Pi, Chrome OS.

Learn More

Cross-compatibility

With the AnyDesk mobile solutions it’s possible to connect and access a desktop or a mobile device remotely with your Android-based smartphone as well as with iPad and iPhone. On top of that, you can connect and access Android and iOS mobile devices with your desktop no matter which operating system is used.

Learn More

Mobile features

The mobile device support of AnyDesk on Android and iOS offers you the following features: Session Recording, File Manager, Clipboard, Wake-On-LAN, Privacy Mode, In-App Tutorials.

Learn More

Mobile Remote Support

The mobile solution of AnyDesk makes it possible to share the screen of Android and iOS devices. This way, you can get or provide support for Android and iOS from any device such as desktops, smartphones, or tablets. On Android it’s possible to not only connect, but also to control the device remotely on all supported devices and with our additional plugin.

Learn More

Mobile Device Management

MDM tools allow IT administrators to integrate all mobile devices into the corporate network and distribute software, updates, and security policies securely and across operating systems. Configure AnyDesk for Android via MDM and centrally manage Android mobile devices. Decide who users can connect to and enable or disable all or selected settings. MDM assures a quick and automated rollout.

Remote Support for Key Industries

AnyDesk delivers fast, secure remote support for the industries that depend on reliable remote access and quick issue resolution. From IT teams to educators and engineers, organizations use AnyDesk to troubleshoot devices, assist users, and keep operations running without interruption.

IT Services

IT teams use AnyDesk to quickly diagnose issues, manage endpoints, and support clients remotely. AnyDesk is lightweight, secure, and scalable, making it ideal for fast incident response and reduced onsite visits.

Education

Schools and universities rely on AnyDesk to support students, teachers, and staff across campus and remote learning environments. Anydesk helps resolve device issues, assist classrooms, and maintain systems from anywhere.

Manufacturing

Manufacturers turn to AnyDesk to troubleshoot machines and workstations without halting production. Provide real-time support, monitor equipment, and keep operations moving with minimal downtime with our remote support software.

Engineering & Design

Engineering and design teams use AnyDesk to access high-performance systems and collaborate securely from any location. It is ideal for editing complex models, reviewing files, and assisting distributed teams.
